capture.what: NEAR's own revenue dashboard: its capture over the last 30 days, as shares of gross fees, by mechanism

checks.detail: On the sampled days of 2025 the fees counted from single swaps come to 100.0% of the official fee figure for the same days.
checks.name: The official fee figure is what partners charge

checks.detail: The three wallets hold 478,818 NEAR more than 30 days earlier, about $1,374,888 at today's price, against $1,680,190 of official revenue. The gap includes price moves and anything the wallets paid out.
checks.name: The revenue wallets grew by about what the official revenue says

checks.detail: Over 30 days our archive-node balances show 405,284 NEAR arriving; SQL over the chain's transfer tables (a third party's saved Dune query) shows 405,283. The largest gap on any one day is under 1 NEAR.
checks.name: Two ways of reading the revenue wallets agree

checks.detail: It is a sum of volume per token, so a swap of Bitcoin for dollars is in it twice. Counting our partner swaps the same way (every swap that touches a token), we get 80% of the official BTC volume, 80% of the official SOL volume, 96% of the official XRP volume over 19 days. A one-sided official figure could not be matched this closely. So we compare partner swaps to the official total on the both-sides basis throughout.
checks.name: The official volume counts both sides of every swap

events.said: NEAR announces that the Intents fee switch is live: protocol fees go to NEAR, and distribution fees are shared between NEAR and its partners.
events.shows: NEAR's share of gross fees goes from 8% in January to 16% in February.

events.said: We found no announcement for that day.
events.shows: Confidential volume appears in NEAR's dataset for the first time.

events.said: Zcash fell by about a third in a day after a counterfeiting bug in its Orchard pool was disclosed. NEAR Intents is a major place to swap Zcash. Nobody official has linked the two.
events.shows: One of the largest days on record: $282M of official volume.

events.said: Confidential Intents goes live for business partners: swaps execute on a private chain with shielded balances and settle back to public NEAR.
events.shows: Confidential volume is still a small share.

events.said: We could not confirm a cause from a source we can link.
events.shows: The largest day on record, $303M, and the largest inflows to NEAR's revenue wallets.

events.said: 1Click swaps settle confidentially by default from this day. The API is unchanged, so integrators change nothing.
events.shows: The confidential share is 40% that day.

events.said: We found no announcement of a staged rollout. It looks like the 27 October default taking effect.
events.shows: The confidential share climbs from 69% to 97%.

events.said: We found no incident report. A burst of one error with completed swaps unchanged points to one sender retrying, not to users being failed. Daily totals cannot show which sender.
events.shows: 41,457 swaps are refunded with one error, INTENT_SUBMIT_FAILED, against 1 the day after. Completed swaps hold at 20,368 to 21,017 a day.

events.said: Tokens on BNB Chain, Polygon and Avalanche move to new asset IDs. We cannot say the two are related.
events.shows: The confidential share dips to 92% the next day.

events.said: The old Bridge API closes, and integrators are told to use the 1Click Swap API.
events.shows: The partner share of official volume has not moved by the end of the window.
